Data quality

The rules the data must meet. The results below are computed in your browser from the public data when the page loads, with the same code that checks the data every night.

Checking…

RuleDatasetRequirementSeverityResult
unique-idsGarmentsEvery garment id is unique.error–
known-categoryGarmentsEvery category is one of the 13 standard categories.error–
dates-orderedGarmentspurchased ≤ divested when both are set.error–
non-negativeGarmentsprice ≥ 0, timesUsedInit ≥ 0, weightG > 0 when set.error–
known-tagsGarmentsEvery tag is in the vocabulary.error–
worn-existsWear logEvery worn id is an existing garment.error–
wears-in-ownershipWear logWears fall within the garment's ownership period. Known exceptions are ignored by the metrics (Q-9).warning–
public-matches-sourcePublic wardrobe dataThe public copy equals garments + days + comparison.error–
materials-coverageGarmentsShare of active garments with a weight and readable materials (reported, no threshold).info–

Datasets

Classification: public readable by anyone (published by choice) · owner-only only the signed-in owner · private not exposed by the app. All data describes one identifiable person, who publishes the public parts by choice.

Garments owner-only

Every garment owned at some point since tracking began, with its details. The source of truth for garment details (decision D-4).

idtextyesGarment id, from the original Sheet's Photo id (e.g. Jackets_and_hoodies-006); also the photo file name.pattern <Category_words>-NNN; unique
categorytextyesThe garment's category. (Category)one of the 13 standard categories

Public wardrobe data public

The world-readable copy for public pages and the MCP server: all garments, the full day-by-day log (as indexes into the garment list) and the comparison items, in one document, so any metric can be computed for any range with one read (decision D-1).

Where
Firestore users/{uid}/public/data
Contract
ODCS data contract
Access
Firestore REST (JSON): firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/threddit-297417/databas…
web app: wardrobediary.io/dashboard
MCP server (Streamable HTTP): wardrobediary.io/mcp
Lineage
from Garments, Wear log, Comparison items: updated in the same write as every change in the app (transactions / batches) – D-1
FieldTypeRequiredDefinitionConstraints
versionintegeryesFormat version (1).
garmentslist of garmentyesAll garments with all their fields (same as dataset garments).
daysmap date → list of integeryesThe wear log as positions in the garments list.
comparisonlist of comparison itemThe comparison items.
